name: TRIANON
title: A gilded frame for quiet conversation.
tagline: Sage velvet. Antique gold. Emperor marble.
description: Seven MARINER living-room references become a wall-free exhibition. Sage velvet seating, open wreath crests and scrolling gilded arms meet Emperor marble tables and a Calacatta console. Modelled foliate relief, fluted piano-black legs and tailored cushions interpret the supplied classic catalogue. Hidden construction and precise finish calibration remain visual interpretations.
